verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a relay, edge proxy, or self-hosted forwarding component for Statsig. The closest items are SDK local evaluation after initialization and SDK-managed caching. Those are adjacent SDK behaviors: they do not show a deployable proxy that keeps flags served during a vendor outage or keeps SDK traffic inside the user's network.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network
